title: Induced EMF in a Moving Conductor
printed_title: **128. 运动导体中的感生电动势**

prose.text: When a conductor moves in a magnetic field that does not change with time, the induced EMF in the conductor is caused not by a vortex electric field, but by another mechanism.
prose.source_text: 如果导体在不随时间改变的磁场中运动，则导体中的感生电动势不是由涡旋电场，而是由另外的原因产生的.

prose.text:
As the conductor moves, its free electrons move with it. The magnetic field therefore exerts the Lorentz force on the charges.

This force moves charges inside the conductor. The induced EMF thus has a "magnetic origin."
prose.source_text: 当导体运动时，它的自由电子也随着它一起运动. 因此，磁场对电荷作用以洛仑兹力. 它使导体内部的电荷移动. 因此，感生电动势具有“磁性起源”.

prose.text: At many power stations on Earth, it is the Lorentz force that moves electrons in moving conductors.
prose.source_text: 地球上的很多发电站，正是洛仑兹力使运动导体中的电子移动.

prose.text:
We now calculate the induced EMF in a rectangular circuit in a uniform magnetic field (Figure 290). Let one side of the circuit, $AB=l$, slide at a constant velocity $\vec{v}$ along sides $BC$ and $AD$.

The conductor AB remains parallel to side $CD$ at all times. The magnetic induction $\vec{B}$ is perpendicular to conductor $AB$ and makes an angle $\alpha$ with its velocity.
prose.source_text: 现在我们计算匀强磁场中矩形回路中的感生电动势（图290）. 设回路的一边$AB=l$，以恒定的速度$\vec{v}$沿着两个边$BC$和$AD$滑动，在所有时间内都保持与$CD$边平行. 磁感应强度$\vec{B}$与导体$AB$垂直，与它的速度的夹角为$\alpha$.

prose.text: Figure 290
prose.label: 图 290

prose.text: The magnitude of the force exerted by the magnetic field on a moving charged particle (see §121) is
prose.source_text: 磁场对运动的带电粒子的作用力（参阅§121），其大小等于

prose.text: $f=|q|vB\sin\alpha$. (12-5)
prose.source_text: $f=|q|vB\sin\alpha$.　(12-5)

prose.text: The motion-induced effective force acts along conductor $AB$. For the EMF calculation, integrate the effective force in (12-5) over the charge's displacement $l$ relative to the conductor:
prose.source_text: 这个力的方向是沿着导体$AB$的方向. 洛仑兹力(12-5)在路程$l$上的功是

prose.text:
$A=f\cdot l=|q|vBl\sin\alpha$.

Here A is the effective-force integral for motion relative to the conductor, not the total magnetic work on a carrier. The magnetic force is perpendicular to the carrier's total velocity, including motion with and within the conductor, so it does no total work on the carrier.
prose.source_text: $A=f\cdot l=|q|vBl\sin\alpha$.

prose.text: The external mechanical agent maintaining the motion of conductor $AB$ supplies the electrical energy. The induced EMF is the conductor-relative effective-force integral per unit charge magnitude:
prose.source_text: 在导体$AB$中的感生电动势是单位正电荷移动的功：

prose.text: $\mathcal{E}_i=\frac{A}{|q|}=vBl\sin\alpha$. (12-6)
prose.source_text: $\mathcal{E}_i=\frac{A}{|q|}=vBl\sin\alpha$.　(12-6)

prose.text: This formula applies to a straight conductor moving at speed $v$ in a uniform magnetic field and having length $l$, under the geometric conditions above. The rod lies along v cross B, perpendicular to both v and B; alpha is the angle between v and B.
prose.source_text: 这个公式对于在匀强磁场中以速度$v$运动的长为$l$的任何导体都是正确的.

prose.text:
The EMF in the other conductors of the circuit is zero because they are not moving. The EMF in the entire circuit $ABCD$ therefore equals $\mathcal{E}_i$ in (12-6).

If the speed $v$ is constant, the EMF remains constant. The current then increases because the total resistance of the circuit decreases as conductor $AB$ moves to the right.
prose.source_text: 在回路的其他导体中电动势等于零，因为它们没有运动.因此，整个回路$ABCD$中的电动势等于$\mathcal{E}_i$(12-6)，如果运动的速度$v$是恒定的，则电动势保持不变. 此时电流增大，因为在导体$AB$向右移动时回路的总电阻减小.

prose.text:
The induced EMF can also be calculated using the law of electromagnetic induction (12-4). The magnetic flux through circuit $ABCD$ is

$\Phi=BS\cos(90^\circ-\alpha)=BS\sin\alpha$.

Here, $90^\circ-\alpha$ is the angle between vector $\vec{B}$ and the normal $\vec{n}$ to the surface of the circuit (Figure 291), and $S$ is the area of circuit $ABCD$. If, at the initial instant $(t=0)$, the distance between conductors $AB$ and $CD$ is $BC$ (Figure 290), then the area changes as the conductor moves according to
prose.source_text: 另一方面，利用电磁感应定律(12-4)也可以计算出感生电动势. 实际上，通过回路$ABCD$的磁通量等于$\Phi=BS\cos(90^\circ-\alpha)=BS\sin\alpha$，式中$90^\circ-\alpha$是矢量$\vec{B}$和回路表面的法线$\vec{n}$之间的夹角（图291），而$S$是回路$ABCD$的面积. 如果认为在初始时刻$(t=0)$导体$AB$距导体$CD$的距离为$BC$（图290），则当导体移动时，面积按下式改变：

prose.text: Figure 291
prose.label: 图 291

prose.text: $S=AB(BC-vt)$.
prose.source_text: $S=AB(BC-vt)$.

prose.text:
During a time interval $\Delta t$, the change in the area of the circuit is

$\Delta S=-lv\Delta t$.

The minus sign indicates that the area decreases. The change in magnetic flux during this interval is

$\Delta\Phi=-Blv\Delta t$ $\sin\alpha$.

Therefore,
prose.source_text: 在$\Delta t$时间内，回路面积的改变量为$\Delta S=-lv\Delta t$. 负号表示面积减小. 在这个时间内磁通量的变化量为$\Delta\Phi=-Blv\Delta t$ $\sin\alpha$. 因此，

prose.text: $\mathcal{E}_i=-\frac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=Blv\sin\alpha$,
prose.source_text: $\mathcal{E}_i=-\frac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=Blv\sin\alpha$，

prose.text: This is the same result obtained earlier in formula (12-6).
prose.source_text: 这正是前面所得到的（公式12-6）.

prose.text:
If the entire circuit $ABCD$ moves in a uniform magnetic field while maintaining its orientation relative to vector $\vec{B}$, the induced EMF in the circuit is zero because the magnetic flux through its area does not change.

This can also be explained as follows: when the circuit moves, forces act on the electrons in conductors $AB$ and $CD$, directed from $B$ to $A$ and from $C$ to $D$, respectively. The total work done by these forces in one clockwise or counterclockwise trip around the circuit is zero.
prose.source_text: 如果整个回路$ABCD$在匀强磁场中运动，并保持相对于矢量$\vec{B}$有一定的方向，则回路中的感生电动势等于零，因为通过回路面积的磁通量不变. 也可以这样解释：当回路运动时，在导体$AB$和$CD$中有力作用在其中的电子上，方向分别为从$B$到$A$和从$C$到$D$. 当沿着回路顺时针或逆时针转一圈时，这些力的总功等于零.

当导体运动时，它的自由电子也随着它一起运动. 因此，磁场对电荷作用以洛仑兹力. 它使导体内部的电荷移动. 因此，感生电动势具有“磁性起源”.
地球上的很多发电站，正是洛仑兹力使运动导体中的电子移动.
现在我们计算匀强磁场中矩形回路中的感生电动势（图290）. 设回路的一边$AB=l$，以恒定的速度$\vec{v}$沿着两个边$BC$和$AD$滑动，在所有时间内都保持与$CD$边平行. 磁感应强度$\vec{B}$与导体$AB$垂直，与它的速度的夹角为$\alpha$.

$f=|q|vB\sin\alpha$.　(12-5)
这个力的方向是沿着导体$AB$的方向. 洛仑兹力(12-5)在路程$l$上的功是
$A=f\cdot l=|q|vBl\sin\alpha$.
在导体$AB$中的感生电动势是单位正电荷移动的功：
$\mathcal{E}_i=\frac{A}{|q|}=vBl\sin\alpha$.　(12-6)
这个公式对于在匀强磁场中以速度$v$运动的长为$l$的任何导体都是正确的.
